# fabric_slice (Resource)

A FABRIC slice, including compute nodes, components, facility ports, switches, and network services. The resource builds a FIM topology and submits it to the [FABRIC orchestrator](https://fabric-testbed.net/). Slice creation and modification are asynchronous; Terraform waits for the orchestrator to reach a terminal state before saving computed runtime fields such as sliver IDs and management IPs.

~> **Note:** Changing `name`, `ssh_key`, `ssh_keys`, or `ssh_key_version` forces the slice to be destroyed and recreated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "fabric_ssh_keys" {
  description = "SSH public keys to install on FABRIC slice nodes."
  type        = list(string)
  sensitive   = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 1: Minimal - one VM at one FABRIC site
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Request a small slice with one compute node at RENC and install the supplied
# SSH public keys for access after provisioning completes.
resource "fabric_slice" "single_vm" {
  name     = "ren-dev-single-vm"
  ssh_keys = var.fabric_ssh_keys

  node {
    name = "login"
    site = "RENC"
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 2: Complete - compute, component, storage, routed network, facility
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Request a richer topology with explicit capacity, a SmartNIC component,
# storage, a routed FABNet service, and a facility port stitch.
resource "fabric_slice" "science_gateway" {
  name             = "ren-science-gateway"
  ssh_keys         = var.fabric_ssh_keys
  ssh_key_version  = 1
  lifetime_hours   = 48
  lease_start_time = "2026-06-15T14:00:00Z"

  node {
    name          = "gateway"
    site          = "RENC"
    host          = "renc-w1"
    instance_type = "fabric.c4.m8.d100"
    image_ref     = "default_ubuntu_22"
    image_type    = "qcow2"
    cores         = 4
    ram           = 8
    disk          = 100
    boot_script   = "echo FABRIC gateway node ready"

    post_boot_execute = [
      "sudo apt-get update",
      "sudo apt-get install -y iperf3",
    ]

    post_update = [
      "sudo systemctl restart ssh",
    ]

    labels {
      ipv4_subnet     = "192.0.2.0/24"
      instance_parent = "renc-w1"
    }

    component {
      name        = "smartnic"
      type        = "SmartNIC"
      model       = "ConnectX-6"
      fablib_name = "gateway-smartnic"

      labels {
        numa = 0
      }
    }

    storage {
      name       = "analysis-data"
      model      = "FABRIC_NetApp_1TB"
      auto_mount = true
    }

    route {
      subnet   = "198.51.100.0/24"
      next_hop = "192.0.2.1"
    }

    post_boot_upload {
      local_path  = "./bootstrap/gateway.sh"
      remote_path = "/home/ubuntu/bootstrap-gateway.sh"
    }
  }

  facility_port {
    name      = "RENC-ESnet"
    site      = "RENC"
    vlan      = "1720"
    bandwidth = 100
    mtu       = 9000

    labels {
      vlan_range = "1700-1799"
      local_name = "esnet-ren"
    }

    interface {
      name = "esnet-uplink"
      vlan = "1720"
    }
  }

  switch {
    name   = "campus-switch"
    site   = "RENC"
    nports = 2

    port_labels {
      vlan_range = "1700-1799"
    }
  }

  network {
    name       = "fabnet"
    type       = "FABNetv4"
    bandwidth  = 10
    site       = "RENC"
    technology = "AL2S"
    subnet     = "192.0.2.0/24"

    gateway {
      ipv4        = "192.0.2.1"
      ipv4_subnet = "192.0.2.0/24"
      mac         = "02:00:00:00:00:01"
    }

    interface {
      node      = "gateway"
      component = "smartnic"
      port      = 0
      name      = "gateway-data"

      labels {
        vlan = "1720"
      }

      sub_interface {
        name      = "gateway-data.1720"
        vlan      = "1720"
        bandwidth = 10
      }
    }

    interface {
      facility = "RENC-ESnet"
      port     = 0
      name     = "facility-uplink"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The slice name shown in FABRIC. Must be unique enough for your project workflow.

~> **Note:** Changing this value forces the slice to be destroyed and recreated.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `facility_port` (Block List) Facility ports to include in the slice topology for stitching to external networks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--facility_port))
- `lease_start_time` (String) Requested lease start time in FABRIC time or RFC3339 format. When omitted, the orchestrator assigns the lease start time after provisioning.
- `lifetime_hours` (Number) Requested slice lease duration in hours. Must be at least `1`. Defaults to `24`.
- `network` (Block List) Network services to include in the FABRIC slice topology. Each block maps to a FABRIC network service sliver. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--network))
- `node` (Block List) Compute nodes to include in the FABRIC slice topology. Each block maps to a FABRIC node sliver. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--node))
- `ssh_key` (String, Sensitive, Deprecated, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Deprecated single SSH public key compatibility alias. Use `ssh_keys` for one or more keys. This value is masked in plan output and state.

~> **Note:** Changing this value forces the slice to be destroyed and recreated.
- `ssh_key_version` (Number) User-controlled version marker for rotating SSH keys. Defaults to `0`.

~> **Note:** Changing this value forces the slice to be destroyed and recreated.
- `ssh_keys` (List of String, Sensitive) SSH public keys to install on slice nodes. Configure exactly one of `ssh_keys` or the deprecated `ssh_key` alias. These values are masked in plan output and state.

~> **Note:** Changing this value forces the slice to be destroyed and recreated.
- `switch` (Block List) FABRIC switch nodes to include in the slice topology. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--switch))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `graph_id` (String) The topology graph identifier assigned by FABRIC after the slice topology is accepted.
- `id` (String) The FABRIC slice identifier assigned by the orchestrator after the slice is created.
- `lease_end_time` (String) Lease end time assigned by the orchestrator after provisioning or renewal.
- `nodes` (Attributes Map) Map of node runtime outputs keyed by node name. Values are assigned by the orchestrator after provisioning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `slice_id` (String) The FABRIC slice identifier assigned by the orchestrator after the slice is created.
- `state` (String) Current slice state assigned by the orchestrator. Common values include:

- `Configuring` - The slice is being provisioned
- `StableOK` - The slice is active and stable
- `StableError` - Provisioning reached a stable state with errors
- `Modifying` - The slice is being modified
- `ModifyOK` - The slice modification completed
- `ModifyError` - The slice modification failed
- `AllocatedOK` - The slice allocation completed
- `AllocatedError` - The slice allocation failed

<a id="nestedblock--network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network`

Required:

- `name` (String) Network service name within the slice topology.

Optional:

- `bandwidth` (Number) Optional bandwidth requested for the network service in Gbps.
- `gateway` (Attributes) Explicit gateway for routed (FABNet/L3VPN) services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network--gateway))
- `interface` (Block List) Node or facility-port interfaces connected to this network service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--network--interface))
- `labels` (Attributes) FABRIC/FIM labels applied to this topology element. Labels are optional placement, addressing, VLAN, and device hints interpreted by FABRIC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network--labels))
- `mirror_direction` (String) Port-mirror direction. Valid values are:

- `Both`
- `RX_Only`
- `TX_Only`
- `both`
- `rx`
- `tx`
- `mirror_from` (String) Name of the source interface to mirror for `PortMirror` services.
- `site` (String) Site for single-site services. Inferred from interfaces when omitted.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet in CIDR form for routed services.
- `technology` (String) Service technology hint (e.g. `AL2S` for L3VPN).
- `type` (String) Network service type. When omitted, the provider infers an L2 type (`L2Bridge`, `L2STS`, or `L2PTP`) from the connected interfaces and sites. Valid values are:

- `L2Bridge`
- `L2STS`
- `L2PTP`
- `L2Path`
- `L2Multisite`
- `FABNetv4`
- `FABNetv6`
- `FABNetv4Ext`
- `FABNetv6Ext`
- `L3VPN`
- `VLAN`
- `MPLS`
- `PortMirror`

Optional:

<a id="nestedblock--node"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node`

Required:

- `name` (String) Node name within the slice topology. Must be unique within the slice.

~> **Note:** Changing this value forces the slice to be destroyed and recreated.
- `site` (String) FABRIC site code where the node is allocated, such as `RENC` or `UKY`.

~> **Note:** Changing this value forces the slice to be destroyed and recreated.

Optional:

- `boot_script` (String) Inline boot script to run on first boot. Limited to `1024` characters.
- `component` (Block List) Hardware components attached to the node, such as GPUs, SmartNICs, FPGAs, NVMe devices, or storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--node--component))
- `cores` (Number) Optional number of CPU cores requested for the node. When omitted, FABRIC uses the instance type or site default.
- `disk` (Number) Optional root disk size requested for the node in GB. When omitted, FABRIC uses the instance type or site default.
- `host` (String) Optional FABRIC host placement hint. Sets `labels.instance_parent` for this node.
- `image_ref` (String) Optional image reference to boot on the node, such as a FABRIC image name or image UUID accepted by the site.
- `image_type` (String) Optional image type associated with `image_ref`, such as `qcow2` when required by the selected image.
- `instance_type` (String) Optional FABRIC instance type name used to select node capacity from the site catalog.
- `labels` (Attributes) FABRIC/FIM labels applied to this topology element. Labels are optional placement, addressing, VLAN, and device hints interpreted by FABRIC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node--labels))
- `post_boot_execute` (List of String) Commands executed on the node after boot, in order. Defaults to no post-boot commands.
- `post_boot_upload` (Block List) Files to upload to the node after boot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--node--post_boot_upload))
- `post_update` (List of String) Commands run after the node package update step. Defaults to no post-update commands.
- `ram` (Number) Optional RAM requested for the node in GB. When omitted, FABRIC uses the instance type or site default.
- `route` (Block List) Static routes to configure in node user-data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--node--route))
- `storage` (Block List) Storage volumes requested for the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--node--storage))

### Nested Schema for `node.component`

Required:

- `name` (String) Component name within the node.

Optional:

- `model` (String) Optional component model to request from the FABRIC catalog, such as `RTX6000`, `ConnectX-6`, or `P4510`.
- `type` (String) Component type to request. Valid values are:

- `GPU`
- `SmartNIC`
- `SharedNIC`
- `FPGA`
- `NVME`
- `Storage`

- `ipv4_range` (String) IPv4 address range in "lo-hi" form.
- `ipv4_subnet` (String) IPv4 subnet label in CIDR form.
- `ipv6` (String) IPv6 address label.
- `ipv6_range` (String) IPv6 address range in "lo-hi" form.
- `ipv6_subnet` (String) IPv6 subnet label in CIDR form.
- `local_name` (String) Local port or device name label.
- `local_type` (String) Local port or device type label.
- `mac` (String) MAC address label.
- `numa` (Number) NUMA label in the range `-1` through `7`.
- `region` (String) External region label.
- `usb_id` (String) USB identifier label.
- `vlan` (String) VLAN tag in the range 0 through 4096.
- `vlan_range` (String) VLAN range in "lo-hi" form.


<a id="nestedblock--node--post_boot_upload"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node.post_boot_upload`

Required:

- `local_path` (String) Path on the machine running Terraform to upload from after the node boots.
- `remote_path` (String) Destination path on the node for the uploaded file.


<a id="nestedblock--node--route"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node.route`

Required:

- `next_hop` (String) Next-hop IP address for the static route.
- `subnet` (String) Destination subnet for the static route in CIDR form.


<a id="nestedblock--node--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node.storage`

Required:

- `name` (String) Storage volume name within the node.

Optional:

- `auto_mount` (Boolean) Whether to request the node-level storage flag in user-data so the volume is auto-mounted. Defaults to `false`.
- `model` (String) Optional FABRIC storage model to request from the catalog.



<a id="nestedblock--switch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `switch`

Required:

- `name` (String) Switch node name within the slice topology.
- `site` (String) FABRIC site code where the switch node is allocated.

Optional:

- `nports` (Number) Optional number of switch ports to request. Must be at least `1` when set.
- `port_labels` (Attributes) FABRIC/FIM labels applied to this topology element. Labels are optional placement, addressing, VLAN, and device hints interpreted by FABRIC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--switch--port_labels))

<a id="nestedatt--switch--port_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `switch.port_labels`

Optional:

- `account_id` (String) External account identifier label.
- `asn` (String) Autonomous system number in the range 1 through 4294967295.
- `bdf` (String) PCI bus-device-function label.
- `bgp_key` (String, Sensitive) BGP peering key. This value is sensitive, masked in plan output and state, and requires asn to be set.
- `device_name` (String) Device name label.
- `inner_vlan` (String) Inner VLAN tag in the range 0 through 4096.
- `instance` (String) FABRIC instance label.
- `instance_parent` (String) FABRIC instance parent label used for host pinning.
- `ipv4` (String) IPv4 address label.
- `ipv4_range` (String) IPv4 address range in "lo-hi" form.
- `ipv4_subnet` (String) IPv4 subnet label in CIDR form.
- `ipv6` (String) IPv6 address label.
- `ipv6_range` (String) IPv6 address range in "lo-hi" form.
- `ipv6_subnet` (String) IPv6 subnet label in CIDR form.
- `local_name` (String) Local port or device name label.
- `local_type` (String) Local port or device type label.
- `mac` (String) MAC address label.
- `numa` (Number) NUMA label in the range `-1` through `7`.
- `region` (String) External region label.
- `usb_id` (String) USB identifier label.
- `vlan` (String) VLAN tag in the range 0 through 4096.
- `vlan_range` (String) VLAN range in "lo-hi" form.



<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `error_message` (String) Error message reported for the node sliver when provisioning or modification fails.
- `graph_node_id` (String) FIM graph node identifier assigned to the node after topology submission.
- `management_ip` (String) Management IP address assigned to the node by FABRIC after provisioning.
- `reservation_state` (String) Reservation state assigned to the node sliver by FABRIC.
- `sliver_id` (String) FABRIC sliver identifier assigned to the node after provisioning.
- `state` (String) Current node sliver state assigned by the orchestrator.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing FABRIC slice by its slice UUID from the FABRIC portal or
# orchestrator slice details.
terraform import fabric_slice.single_vm 3f1b62c1-7a5e-4f46-b4ea-58d8df8c0d70
```
